product.name: Monoprice SYNC-ANC Bluetooth Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling and aptX Low Latency
product.description: Monoprice™Bluetooth® Headphones with Active Noise CancellingWith the AAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, and Qualcomm aptX Low Latency audio codecsThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling are the perfect headphones for enjoying high‑quality audio streaming without the distraction of outside noises. They feature a Bluetooth 5 radio with support for the AAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, and Qualcomm aptX Low Latency audio codecs. aptX provides for superior, high‑quality Bluetooth streaming, while aptX Low Latency ensures synchronized, lag‑free audio for video transmissions.Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling blocks unwanted, outside noise, while Qualcomm cVc™ Echo Cancelling and Noise Suppression ensures crystal‑clear, noise‑free voice for phone calls. Multipoint Pairing allows you to pair two source devices for seamless switching between sources. Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling provide the perfect blend of style, comfort, and audio performance.Bluetooth® 5 wireless connectionSupports the AAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, and Qualcomm aptX Low Latency audio codecsQualcomm cVc™ Echo Cancelling and Noise Suppression ensures crystal‑clear, noise‑free voice for phone callsHybrid Active Noise Cancelling works with both wired and wireless connectionsUp to 20 hours of audio playback/talk timeMultipoint Pairing allows for seamless switching between audio sources CD QUALITY SOUNDThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling features a range of high‑quality audio codecs for the best sound possible. It includes the standard AAC and SBC codecs, as well as the more advanced Qualcomm® aptX™ and Qualcomm aptX Low Latency codecs. LONG DISTANCE CONNECTIONSThe Bluetooth® radio features a range of up to 32 feet (10 meters), giving you the freedom to move around without being tethered by wires. SYNCHRONIZED AUDIO AND VIDEOThe Qualcomm® aptX™ Low Latency codec removes any possible lag from the audio, ensuring that the audio is perfectly synchronized with your movies and games. MULTIPOINT CONNECTIONThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Receiver allows you to connect up to two source devices at the same time, allowing for seamless switching between sources. HANDS‑FREE PHONE CALLSThe built‑in microphone allows you to make and receive phones calls, while Qualcomm cVc™ Echo Cancelling and Noise Suppression ensures crystal‑clear, noise‑free voice transmissions. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
